description: Source code for STM32F10x CEC peripheral firmware functions, including initialization, control, and status functions for the CEC hardware module.

methods.name: CEC_DeInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the CEC peripheral registers to their default reset values.

methods.name: CEC_Init
methods.description: Initializes the CEC peripheral with specified parameters.

methods.name: CEC_Cmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the CEC peripheral.

methods.name: CEC_ITConfig
methods.description: Enables or disables the CEC interrupt.

methods.name: CEC_OwnAddressConfig
methods.description: Sets the CEC device's own address.

methods.name: CEC_SendDataByte
methods.description: Transmits a single data byte via CEC.

methods.name: CEC_ReceiveDataByte
methods.description: Receives the latest data byte from CEC.

methods.name: CEC_EndOfMessageCmd
methods.description: Transmits message with or without an End Of Message (EOM) bit.

methods.name: CEC_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of a specific CEC flag.

methods.name: CEC_GetITStatus
methods.description: Checks whether a specific CEC interrupt has occurred.

methods.name: CEC_ClearITPendingBit
methods.description: Clears specified CEC interrupt pending bits.
